remarks: Welcome to this spacious 1,800 sqft ranch-style home, situated on over a quarter-acre of land on a quiet street in a desirable well-maintained neighborhood! Featuring four bedrooms and one full bathroom, this home offers plenty of space and versatility to suit your needs. Hardwood floors run throughout most of the home, adding warmth and character, and the open-concept living-dining area provides a spacious and functional place to gather and entertain! The additional family room has a cozy gas-stove and tons of natural light. This area also gives access to the partially finished basement and rear yard. The basement area has great potential for an in-home office or hobby space, and it also houses the mechanicals of the home, including an updated furnace, 1-year old hot water tank and a radon mitigation system. Off the back of the home you will find a large covered concrete patio and a spacious flat yard that is sure to meet all your needs. The rear end of the yard has electric installed which makes it an ideal space to add a pool or additional outdoor space to entertain! The vinyl-sided exterior offers easy maintenance, while the double-wide driveway provides ample off-street parking. With generous living space, a flexible layout, spacious yard, and a prime location, this move-in ready home is waiting for its next owner to make it their own!
